text:
elaine_cs: Heads up — several EU trial tenants reporting "activation pending" longer than expected after ingest. Seeing a cluster of reports starting ~22:10 UTC. Drafting a customer note, need quick review and mitigation actions.

maria_cs: thanks, can you paste the list of affected tenant IDs? we should prioritize high-touch accounts first. :eyes: 

elaine_cs: short list here: tenant_421, tenant_88-prod, tenant-eu-510, plus 5 trials (DMing full list). Major ask from finance for renewal-impact flagging.

sam_sre: looked into infra — indexer queue spiked after a large reindex job kicked in for an opt-in beta. That job consumed CPU and db connections, causing delays in activation hooks. We throttled the job and restarted the queue workers. Seeing partial recovery.

josh_reliability: thanks Sam. Can we add a temporary fallback to the old activation path (no reindex dependency) for high-touch tenants? If so we can unblock them in 15–20m.

sam_sre: yes, we can toggle fallback for specific tenant IDs. I'll run target toggle now.

deploy_bot: [alert] job/reindex-beta-2024 restarted by sam_sre at 2024-08-12T22:29:10Z.

mike_product: For customer comms — propose a short transparent note with: (1) what happened, (2) our mitigation and ETA, (3) any customer-visible action, (4) goodwill (credit/office hours). I can draft language.

elaine_cs: please draft. keep it plain: no jargon, include ETA and how to reach our team. Mention we can manually trigger activation if they want immediate help.

mike_product: Draft below — feedback welcome:

Hi <Customer>,

We’re sorry — some activations in our EU region are delayed due to an internal indexing backlog. We’ve throttled the background job, restarted the processing queue, and enabled a temporary activation fallback for priority tenants.

ETA for full recovery: within 1 hour.
Immediate options: reply to this message and we can manually trigger activation for affected projects.
As a thank-you, we’ll apply a one-time credit for any projects delayed over 30 minutes.

We’ll follow up when the backlog is fully cleared.
Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood Inference Team

maria_cs: looks good. Suggest adding contact: support@redwood.ai or reply to your CS rep.

sam_sre: current metrics show worker backlog decreasing; I expect full clearance in ~45 minutes. changing ETA to "within 1 hour" is safe.

elaine_cs: okay — finalizing message. I'll send to impacted tenants and include individual notes for tenant_421 and tenant-eu-510 (high-touch).

josh_reliability: follow-up action: will add an alert to detect when a single reindex job takes >20% of indexer capacity. Sam — can you create a short runbook snippet for CS to trigger manual activation?

sam_sre: will add 2-step runbook in #eng-oncall within 30m. Steps: (1) toggle fallback flag, (2) queue retry command `POST /internal/activation/retry {tenant_id}`.

elaine_cs: perfect. after messages go out, CS will offer office hours for any customers who want a walkthrough. I'll post the sent messages here after dispatch. :white_check_mark:
